title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone / hosted-global / hosted-per-page
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision <timestamp>: Error: Timed out after ~260-300s waiting for Blazor WASM root session for resource 'hosted-global'/'hosted-per-page'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}
analysis: Both hosted-global and hosted-per-page Blazor debugger E2E tests time out after ~300 seconds waiting for the WASM root debug session to attach, with no explicit error beyond the timeout. This exact pattern has recurred 22 times previously (issue #19618), indicating an environmental/timing issue in the Blazor WASM debug session bootstrap on the Linux E2E runner rather than a code regression. The PR only changes Radius installation pins/tests and does not touch the VS Code extension or Blazor debugging code.
